create_ReadTensor_instance: create a ReadTensor instance with a name and numpy array data to track tensor reading state
read_tensor_values_with_clamp: read values from the tensor with optional min and max clamping using the Read method
read_vector3_from_tensor: read a 3D vector from the tensor with optional x, y, z axis selection using ReadVector3
read_rotation3d_from_tensor: read a 3D rotation from the tensor by consuming two consecutive Vector3 values using ReadRotation3D
get_tensor_as_device_tensor: get the underlying data as a float32 PyTorch tensor moved to the device using GetTensor
